description: A trap: the ebay connection reads 'degraded' ONLY because one token is expiring_soon (within 7 days) — but errored=0, all connections active, refresh healthy, and it is NOT yet expired. Backlog is 0 (no stuck/failed batches, no conflicts, no orphan sales). It LOOKS actionable but the correct move is to note the expiring-soon connection and DO NOTHING: no file_task (the charter files that only for an EXPIRED token needing the user to reconnect, not a healthy soon-to-expire one auto-refresh will handle) and no retry_job (no backlog to unstick).

memo.summary: 1 marketplace(s) degraded/down; backlog flat vs prior (0→0).
